prompt: Create a highly realistic cinematic travel portrait of a stylish young man with curly dark hair, light stubble, and medium tan skin sitting relaxed on old rough stone steps on a coastal cliff at golden hour sunset. He is centered in the lower half of a vertical frame, seated with legs apart, elbows resting on knees, hands loosely clasped, looking off to the right with a calm confident expression. He wears a loose cream linen button-up shirt with thin vertical stripes, beige wide-leg linen trousers, white sneakers, aviator sunglasses, and a black wristwatch. Behind him is a dramatic Mediterranean-style rocky coastline with cliffs receding into the distance on the right, calm ocean on the left, low shrubs and dry coastal vegetation in the foreground, and the sun near the horizon casting a bright golden reflection across the water. The sky is filled with warm orange clouds and soft atmospheric haze. Use natural backlighting, warm rim light on hair and shoulders, realistic skin texture, shallow-to-medium depth of field, detailed stone texture, soft filmic contrast, warm orange and amber color grading, and a premium lifestyle photography aesthetic. Vertical portrait composition, 2:3 aspect ratio, shot at eye level with a slight telephoto feel, no text, no watermark, no extra people.

promptZh: 创作一张高度写实的电影感旅行人像，画面主体为 一位留着深色卷发、带有浅胡茬、肤色呈中等古铜色的时尚年轻男子，他正悠闲地坐在海岸悬崖边古老的粗糙石阶上，时间设定在日落的黄金时刻。他位于竖构图画面的下半部分中心，双腿分开坐着，手肘撑在膝盖上，双手自然交握，神情平静自信，目光看向右侧。他身着 一件带有细竖条纹的宽松奶油色亚麻衬衫、米色阔腿亚麻长裤、白色运动鞋、飞行员太阳镜和黑色腕表。背景是极具地中海风情的岩石海岸线，右侧悬崖向远处延伸，左侧是平静的海洋，前景点缀着低矮灌木和干燥的海岸植被，太阳靠近地平线，在水面上投射出明亮的金色倒影。天空布满温暖的橙色云彩和柔和的大气薄雾。采用自然逆光，头发和肩部带有温暖的轮廓光，呈现真实的皮肤质感、中浅景深、细腻的石材纹理、柔和的电影感对比度、温暖的橙琥珀色调，以及高级生活方式摄影美学。竖构图人像，2:3 宽高比，平视拍摄，带有轻微的长焦感，无文字，无水印，画面中无其他人物。
